tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: list-items
tools.description: List files and folders inside a OneDrive folder. Defaults to the drive root. Address the folder by itemId or by path.

itemId.description: Folder item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Folder path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents/Reports". Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 50, max: 200)

tools.name: get-item
tools.description: Get metadata for a single OneDrive file or folder, addressed by itemId or by path.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents/notes.txt". Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: search-items
tools.description: Search OneDrive for files and folders matching a free-text query.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 200)

tools.name: download-file
tools.description: Download a OneDrive file and save it to the local filesystem. Files above 50 MB are refused.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: File path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: get-file-content
tools.description: Read the contents of a text-based OneDrive file inline, without saving it to disk. Limited to 1 MB.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: File path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: convert-file
tools.description: Convert a OneDrive document (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other supported types) to PDF and save it locally. Files above 50 MB are refused.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: File path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: upload-file
tools.description: Upload a local file to OneDrive. Files below 4 MB upload directly; larger files use a chunked upload session — a failed chunk aborts the whole upload rather than resuming. Overwrites an existing file with the same name.

localPath.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload

destinationPath.description: Destination folder path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents". Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Defaults to the root.

fileName.description: Name to store the file under, as a literal name rather than a pre-encoded one. Defaults to the local file name.

tools.name: create-folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in OneDrive. Address the containing folder with parentId or parentPath; with neither, the folder is created at the drive root.

parentId.description: ID of the folder to create the new folder inside. Takes precedence over parentPath. Defaults to the drive root.

parentPath.description: Path of the folder to create the new folder inside, relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents/Reports". Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Defaults to the drive root.

conflictBehavior.description: What to do if the name exists: "rename" (default), "replace", or "fail".

tools.name: copy-item
tools.description: Copy a OneDrive file or folder to another folder. Waits for the copy to finish before returning. Specify the item with itemId or path, and the destination with destinationFolderId or destinationPath; with neither destination, the copy is placed at the drive root.

itemId.description: Item ID to copy. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path of the item to copy, relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

destinationFolderId.description: Destination folder ID. Takes precedence over destinationPath.

destinationPath.description: Destination folder path relative to the drive root. Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Omitting both destination arguments copies to the drive root.

newName.description: Optional new name for the copy

tools.name: move-item
tools.description: Move a OneDrive file or folder into a different folder. Specify the item with itemId or path, and the destination with destinationFolderId or destinationPath; with neither destination, the item is moved to the drive root.

itemId.description: Item ID to move. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path of the item to move, relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

destinationFolderId.description: Destination folder ID. Takes precedence over destinationPath.

destinationPath.description: Destination folder path relative to the drive root. Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Omitting both destination arguments moves the item to the drive root.

tools.name: rename-item
tools.description: Rename a OneDrive file or folder without moving it.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

newName.description: The new name for the item

tools.name: delete-item
tools.description: Delete a OneDrive file or folder. The item moves to the recycle bin, but this app cannot restore it.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: create-share-link
tools.description: Create a sharing link for a OneDrive item, with a chosen permission level and audience.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: invite-people
tools.description: Share a OneDrive item with specific people by email, granting read or write access.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

message.description: Optional message included in the invitation

requireSignIn.description: Whether recipients must sign in (default: true)

sendInvitation.description: Whether to email the invitation (default: true)

tools.name: list-permissions
tools.description: List everyone and every sharing link that currently has access to a OneDrive item.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: remove-permission
tools.description: Revoke a sharing grant or link on a OneDrive item. Use list-permissions to find the permission ID.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: list-shared-with-me
tools.description: List OneDrive files and folders that other people have shared with this account. Listing only: a shared item lives on the drive of the person who shared it, and every other tool in this app addresses /me/drive, so the IDs returned here cannot be passed to get-item, download-file, or any other tool. Use webUrl to open a shared item.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 50, max: 200)

tools.name: list-recent
tools.description: List OneDrive files this account accessed recently, most recent first.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 25, max: 200)

tools.name: get-drive-info
tools.description: Get information about the OneDrive account, including storage quota and usage.

tools.name: list-versions
tools.description: List the version history of a OneDrive file. Use this to recover an earlier version after an unwanted overwrite.

itemId.description: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
